The operational process described in the text highlights a significant bottleneck: the reliance on paper-based processes for expense reporting and approval. This manual approach causes a backlog of unprocessed claims, delayed reimbursements, and employee dissatisfaction, while also increasing the risk of human error during data entry. An efficiency improvement would be to implement a digital expense management system to automate reporting, approvals, and reimbursements, thereby reducing delays and minimizing errors.

The color of a common crow is black.
